mentions.h: June 19/20 1982 - CRYSTAL PALACE - SCAAA SENIOR CHAMPIONSHIPS

photos.c: John Gladwin sits in on Pete Brown(TVH) & John Walker in the Southern Counties Senior 800m Champs where he gained Silver. Stu Paton ducked under 1.50 for the first time in this race and is lurking in the pack.

photo.caption: John Gladwin sits in on Pete Brown(TVH) & John Walker in the Southern Counties Senior 800m Champs where he gained Silver. Stu Paton ducked under 1.50 for the first time in this race and is lurking in the pack.
